name: Real-Debrid Resolver
description: Automatically unlocks and debrids supported download links using your Real-Debrid account.
cmd.account.title: Configure & Verify Real-Debrid Account
op.account.title: Account & Settings
op.account.desc: Save your Real-Debrid API token and verify your subscription status. Leave the token blank to re-check your currently saved key.
op.apiKey.label: Real-Debrid API Token
op.apiKey.help: Optional if already saved. Stored locally on your machine.
op.enabled.label: Enable automatic unrestricting
op.enabled.help: Automatically intercept and unlock supported filehoster links.
op.showNotification.label: Show notifications
op.showNotification.help: Display desktop notifications when links are unrestricted or fail.
op.plan.free: Free (Premium subscription required to unrestrict paid hosters)
op.error.missingKey: No API token provided or saved yet. Paste your token above from real-debrid.com/apitoken.
op.error.invalidToken: Invalid or rejected Real-Debrid API token.
op.error.networkError: Could not reach Real-Debrid servers. Check your internet connection.
settings.title: Real-Debrid
settings.apiKey.title: Real-Debrid API Token
settings.apiKey.desc: Your personal Real-Debrid API token (available at real-debrid.com/apitoken).
settings.enabled.title: Enable Automatic Unrestricting
settings.enabled.desc: Automatically intercept and unrestrict supported file hoster links.
settings.showNotification.title: Show Notifications
settings.showNotification.desc: Display notifications when links are unrestricted or account status updates.
notif.unlocked.title: Link unrestricted successfully!
notif.unrestrictFailed.title: Real-Debrid — Unrestrict Failed
notif.keyRegistered.title: Real-Debrid — API Key Saved
notif.keyRegisteredFree.body: Account {{username}} saved, but it is a Free plan (Premium is required for paid hosters).
notif.invalidKey.body: The provided Real-Debrid API token is invalid.
notif.error.hosterNotFree: Real-Debrid Premium subscription required for this host (hoster_not_free).
notif.error.badToken: Invalid or expired Real-Debrid API token (bad_token).
notif.error.unavailableFile: This file is unavailable or offline on the hoster (unavailable_file).

notif.error.hosterMaintenance: This hoster is currently under maintenance on Real-Debrid.
notif.error.trafficExhausted: Real-Debrid traffic or daily limit reached for this hoster.
notif.configRequired.title: Real-Debrid — Configuration Required
notif.configRequired.body: Open Extensions ➔ Real-Debrid Resolver ➔ Operations to save your API token.
notif.account.premium.title: Real-Debrid — Premium Active
notif.account.nonPremium.title: Real-Debrid — Non-Premium
